ui.output.hint_compo: With the EXR container, the program writes the file itself, in floating point: colour (HDR values above 1 are kept) and output passes, one file per frame. Passes are declared in the shader (// aov depth=bufferB.r, // aov normal=bufferC.rgb, // aov alpha) or in the field above, separated by semicolons; “motion” alone writes motion vectors ESTIMATED between two frames. Depth and ids are always 32-bit. Depth bounds (near:far) normalise the depth and are declared in the file. Alpha is written straight or premultiplied and declared in EXR and in the floating-point TIFF (other formats cannot declare it). ffmpeg reads the main layer only, and clips values above 1.
